## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The missing-file fallback added to `load_results` must be fixed before merge, because it makes the release gate pass when no results file exists.

## Changes
The pull request makes `load_results` return an empty list when the results file is absent and adds `display_preferences`, which falls back to a light theme when the preferences file is absent. It also adds an unused `REVIEW_NOTE` constant and a new test file covering the release gate and preference loading.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — silent-failure — Fail the release gate when the results file is missing — A missing results file makes `release_allowed` return True: `load_results` now returns `[]` on `FileNotFoundError`, and `all()` over an empty sequence at app/results.py:12 is True. Before this change the error propagated; now nothing logs or signals the fallback. — A release whose checks never ran, or whose results path is wrong, passes the gate with no signal to operators. — Fix: Let `FileNotFoundError` propagate from `load_results` as before, or return False from `release_allowed` for a missing file, and extend `test_saved_checks_control_release` with the missing-file case.
